args.content:
Hawaii Packing List
Based on: Emma Johnson's Vacation Itinerary (June 10-20, 2024)

Essential Documents & Money:
- Passport/ID
- Travel itinerary
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Credit/debit cards
- Cash (USD)
- Travel insurance documents

Clothing:
- Swimwear (2-3 sets)
- Casual outfits for beach days
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Light jacket for evening (North Shore road trip on June 15)
- Luau-appropriate attire (June 16)
- Walking shoes/sneakers
- Sandals/water shoes
- Hat and sunglasses
- Light rain jacket

Beach & Water Activities:
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun aloe vera
- Reusable water bottle
- Beach bag
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (or rent at Hanauma Bay on June 12)
- Kayaking equipment rental confirmation (Kailua Beach, June 18)

Electronics:
- Camera with extra batteries
- Phone charger
- Portable power bank
- Underwater camera (optional)
- Earbuds/headphones

Health & Personal Care:
- Medications
- First aid kit
- Travel-size toiletries
- Insect repellent
- Lip balm with SPF
- Aloe vera gel (for sunburn relief)
- Motion sickness medication (for road trip)

Shopping & Souvenirs:
- Lightweight backpack/bag (for Ala Moana Center shopping on June 19)
- Reusable shopping bags

Relaxation:
- Book/goodreads
- Journal for documenting the trip
- Comfortable hotel slippers (for June 17 spa day)

Specific Activity Items:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach towel, beach chair rental
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay): Snorkel mask, underwater camera
- June 13 (Diamond Head): Hiking backpack, water, snacks
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Comfortable shoes for walking
- June 15 (North Shore): Camera, picnic supplies
- June 16 (Polynesian Cultural Center): Camera, comfortable walking shoes
- June 18 (Kailua Beach): Kayak rental confirmation, water shoes
- June 19 (Ala Moana Center): Shopping bags, cash/cards

Notes:
- June 10: Arrival - pack light for plane
- June 20: Departure - ensure all belongings collected
- Check weather forecast before departure
- Confirm spa appointment for June 17
